# Alya Blade / Alya Bıçak - Industrial Cutting Solutions
# https://alyablade.com | https://alyabicak.com

## Company Overview
Alya Tekstil Sanayi Ticaret Ltd. Şti. is a leading manufacturer and distributor of industrial cutting blades, machine knives, and precision razors. Established in 1996, based in Istanbul, Turkey, serving 35+ countries worldwide.

## Core Products
- Industrial Razor Blades (Sheffield, UK quality)
- Trapezoid/Utility Blades
- Safety Knives & Cutters
- Machine Knives for Textile Industry
- Food Industry Cutting Blades
- Packaging & Paper Cutting Blades
- Circular & Round Blades
- Custom Manufacturing Solutions

## Product Categories
1. Trapez Jiletler / Trapezoid Blades - Heavy-duty utility cutting
2. Kanca Bıçaklar / Hook Blades - Safe cutting for packaging
3. Yuvarlak Köşe Jiletler / Round Corner Blades - Safety razors
4. Sıyırma Bıçakları / Skiving Blades - Leather and textile
5. Endüstriyel Jiletler / Industrial Razors - Precision cutting
6. Güvenlik Bıçakları / Safety Knives - Workplace safety
7. Makine Bıçakları / Machine Knives - Industrial machinery

## Quality & Origin
- Sheffield, England manufacturing heritage
- Durham Duplex authorized distributor
- ISO 9001:2015 certified processes
- Premium carbon steel and stainless steel materials

## Business Model
B2B wholesale and distribution. Custom blade manufacturing available.
Minimum order quantities apply. Export to EU, Middle East, Central Asia, Balkans.

## Key Differentiators
- 30+ years industry experience
- Direct Sheffield supplier relationships
- Multi-language customer support
- Technical consultation services
- Fast delivery to 35+ countries
